android.home.share_sub:
Listen together with people nearby
to the sound playing on this phone
android.home.empty_sub: When someone on the same Wi-Fi starts sharing, it shows up here
android.home.empty_hint: Public Wi-Fi in cafés and hotels often blocks devices from reaching each other, so rooms may not show up. Ask the host to turn on ‘Connect without Wi-Fi’ and join that hotspot.
android.home.by_code: Can't see the room? Join with a room code
android.home.discovery_failed: Can't search for nearby rooms — try joining with a room code
android.host.hint_no_wifi: No one can join right now. Connect to Wi-Fi, or turn on a hotspot with ‘Connect without Wi-Fi’ below.
android.host.hint_code: On a Mac or PC, enter the code at {site}. Phones can join right away with the app or the QR.
android.host.stop_body: Everyone listening will lose the sound. If you share again, the room code and password will change.
android.host.hotspot_closed: Turned off the hotspot along with sharing
android.qr.title: Join with QR
android.qr.lead: Scan with the camera on a phone that's on the same Wi-Fi to join right away
android.listen.title: Listening together
android.listen.muted: Muted — tap the center to hear it again
android.listen.hint: Tap the center to mute · Use the side buttons for volume
android.create.title: Create a room
android.create.lead: People nearby will see this name
android.create.consent_new:
Tap ‘Share screen’ on the next screen to start.
Only music and video sound is sent — never your screen, notification sounds, or calls.
android.create.consent_old:
Tap ‘Start now’ on the next screen to start.
Only music and video sound is sent — never your screen, notification sounds, or calls.
android.pin.lead: The 4-digit password on the host's screen
android.code.title: Join with a room code
android.code.lead:
It's the code shown large in the middle of the host's screen.
It includes the password, so you don't need to type it separately.
android.code.error: Can't read this code — please check it again
android.direct.title: Join by address
android.direct.lead: Use this on Wi-Fi that blocks automatic discovery. The address is in the host's Settings › Connection info.
android.settings_sheet.battery_exempt: Excluded — stays connected even after a long time
android.settings_sheet.battery_warn: Your phone may stop the app during long sharing sessions
android.share.switch_body:
You can't share and listen at the same time — the sound you send and the sound you hear would loop into each other.

To share again, you'll need to approve screen recording once more.
android.hotspot.title: Connect without Wi-Fi
android.hotspot.lead: This phone creates its own Wi-Fi. Friends just scan the QR with their camera to join.
android.hotspot.manual:
If that doesn't work, enter it manually
{ssid}  /  {pw}
android.hotspot.on_info: The hotspot is on. Find the password in Settings › Hotspot.
android.hotspot.cant_turn_off: The app can't turn off a hotspot started from Settings
android.hotspot.on_no_pw: The hotspot is on, but its password can't be read — check Settings
android.hotspot.on_check_settings: Hotspot on — find the password in Settings › Hotspot
android.hotspot.system_on: A hotspot is already on — friends can join with the password shown in Settings
android.hotspot.airplane: Can't turn on a hotspot in airplane mode
android.hotspot.no_wifi: Wi-Fi isn't available on this device
android.hotspot.no_response: The hotspot isn't responding — try turning it on in Settings
android.hotspot.need_nearby: Can't turn on a hotspot without the Nearby devices permission
android.hotspot.need_location: This Android version needs location permission to turn on a hotspot
android.player.too_many: Too many attempts — try again later
android.player.gave_up: Disconnected for over 2 minutes, so listening stopped
ios.listen.pw_message: Enter the 4-digit number shown on the host's screen.
ios.listen.ended_hint: When the host starts sharing again, it shows up in the list below as a new room.
ios.listen.state_too_many: Too many attempts. Please try again later
ios.listen.state_lost: Can't connect — the room may have ended, or you may be on a different Wi-Fi
ios.listen.no_wifi: Not connected to Wi-Fi. Connect to the same Wi-Fi as the host, or to the host's hotspot.
ios.listen.no_rooms:
No rooms found yet. Check that the host has started sharing.
Public Wi-Fi in places like cafés can block devices from reaching each other — if so, use the host's ‘Connect without Wi-Fi’ hotspot.
ios.listen.code_lead: It's the code shown on the host's screen. Use it when the room doesn't appear in the list.
ios.listen.code_error: Can't read this code. Please check it again.
ios.share.title: Share my iPhone's sound
ios.share.listening_warn: You're listening to another room. Starting to share will stop listening.
ios.share.start_hint: In the window that opens, tap ‘Start Broadcast’. Sharing starts after 3 seconds.
ios.share.friend_hint: Friends can enter the code under ‘Room code’ in the IEUM app, or in a browser at {site}.
ios.share.lock_hint: Sharing stops if your iPhone locks. When you put your phone down, tap ‘Lock screen’. It goes dark as if it were off, but sharing keeps going.
ios.share.tip_play_first: Start playing in your music app first so friends hear it right away.
ios.share.tip_lock: If the screen locks, iPhone ends the broadcast. While sharing, use IEUM's ‘Lock screen’ instead of the side button.
ios.share.tip_no_screen: Your screen is never sent. iPhone only provides other apps' sound through ‘Screen Broadcast’, which is why the recording indicator appears.
ios.share.tip_drm: Some apps, like Apple Music, may not be captured because of copy protection.
ios.share.tip_wifi: Friends need to be on the same Wi-Fi as you, or connected to your Personal Hotspot.
ios.qr.title: Join with QR
ios.qr.lead: Scan with the camera on a phone that's on the same Wi-Fi to join right away
iosplist.app.local_network: Local network access is needed to find friends' rooms on the same Wi-Fi and to share sound with them.
iosplist.ext.local_network: Local network access is needed to send sound to friends on the same Wi-Fi.
page.enter_pw: Enter the password the host gave you
page.fine: Keeps playing with the screen off · Use the side buttons for volume
page.fine_ios: Safari may stop the sound when the screen turns off · The app keeps playing
page.app_link_sub: With the app, it keeps playing with the screen off and the delay is shorter
page.playing_bg: Playing — keeps going with the screen off
page.muted: Muted — tap the center to hear it again
page.too_many: Too many attempts — please try again later
page.unreachable: Can't connect — the room may have ended, or you may be on a different Wi-Fi
page.http_too_many: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
site.lead: Enter the room code shown on the host's screen to listen together right here in your browser.
site.help_same_wifi_html: You need to be on the same Wi-Fi as the host's phone (or on the host's hotspot).
site.help_public_wifi_html: Public Wi-Fi in cafés, hotels, and airports blocks devices from reaching each other, so it won't work even on the same network. Ask the host to turn on ‘Connect without Wi-Fi’ in the app, join that hotspot, and try again.
site.help_mac_chrome_html: If Chrome on a Mac says it can't connect, turn on Chrome in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Local Network and restart it. Safari works without any setup.
site.help_new_code: The code changes when the host starts sharing again.
site.bad_code: That code doesn't look right — please check it again
site.came_back: Didn't connect? Check the tips below
